why_not_curated: CCCBDB (Landolt-Bornstein II/7, 1976) gives only the heavy-atom skeleton and one C-H distance, no hydrogen positions and no Cartesians. Recommend: transcribe a complete gas-phase structure from the primary electron-diffraction / microwave literature, or use the PubChem3D conformer (CID 176, public domain) refined by own HF/6-31G (B5).
